title: International on the Kit
style: world fusion, live band funk soul, afrobeat groove, killer drum kit feature, congas djembe shakers, wah guitar, fender rhodes, slap bass, brass section stabs, 110 BPM, festival main stage energy, call and response, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro - drum solo, four bars]
(kit calls the room to order)
Bongo Bob — international
Four years with The Hart, now I'm with the family

[Verse 1]
From the festival circuit to the studio floor
Bongo on the kit — give the people more
Played with every band, played in every key
Now I'm number five, riding with the family
Corey on the bars, Michelle on the court
Zynrose in the cloud, Rafa with the report
Five of us strong, one mansion, one stage
Bongo lays the pocket — turn the page

[Pre-Chorus]
Kick on the one, snare on the two
Hi-hat tells the truth and the truth is true
International on the kit
Wherever the band is, that's where I sit

[Chorus]
Bongo Bob, international
Play the song till the room gets emotional
Pocket so deep you could sleep in there
Groove so wide you could share the air
Bongo Bob, international
Making every band sound exceptional

[Verse 2]
The Hart taught me how to listen first
Play the silence — that's the verse
Then the verse — that's the breath
Then the breath — that's the rest
Now I bring it to the VDS Mansion crew
Blue and gold light, sound coming through
Brass section stabs, rhodes on the ride
Family on the stage, nowhere to hide

[Pre-Chorus]
Kick on the one, snare on the two
Hi-hat tells the truth and the truth is true
International on the kit
Wherever the band is, that's where I sit

[Chorus]
Bongo Bob, international
Play the song till the room gets emotional
Pocket so deep you could sleep in there
Groove so wide you could share the air
Bongo Bob, international
Making every band sound exceptional

[Drum Break - 8 bars]
(let the kit speak)

[Outro - call and response with band]
Bongo: "Where we play?"
Band: "International!"
Bongo: "How we play?"
Band: "Exceptional!"
Bongo: "Who we with?"
Band: "The family!"
(big band stop)
